My pizza burgers are good. My nephew says they are the best.

For this recipe, you will need: ground sirloin, Ragu pizza sauce, Sargentto mozarella cheese, Kraft parmesan cheese, butter.

  1. Make a beef patty out of the ground sirloin. Not too thick, not too thin. Make sure you firm the edges.

  2. Heat up a square griddle pan on top of the stove. Have a baking sheet (like for baking cookies) nearby. I use half-heat. You stove may vary.

  3. Put parmesan cheese on top of the beef. Don't use too much. Just a few sprinkles.

  4. Throw butter in the pan, smush it around so it melts and starts to sizzle.

  5. Put meat patty in pan and cook parmesan side up.

  6. Flip burger with spatula. Be careful not to burn yourself.

  7. Wait for around 30 seconds, then pour pizza sauce on meat patty. Then dump a handful of mozzarella cheese.

  8. Wait for the mozzarella cheese to start to melt.

  9. Put baking sheet on top of pan. Resist the temptation to keep peeking under it. The cheese should start to get just the slightest bit brown.

  10. Remove baking sheet, throw it in the sink because it might have burned mozzarella cheese stuck to the bottom.

  11. If the cheese is gooey and slightly starting to brown, then shut off the stove and put pizza burger on plate.

  12. Double-check to make sure stove is off. Pour water into the pan so that it's easier to clean later.

  13. Enjoy.

Sometimes, as a side dish, I buy a tube of supermarket brand biscuit dough, mush it together into a big blob and make a giant ball of bread.
